title: Depend on primitives read from objects

slides.text: An object prop as a dependency 📦
slides.say: Your component gets an options object as a prop, and the Effect depends on it.
If the parent creates that object during rendering, it is new every time the parent renders. Your chat reconnects for nothing.
Read the primitive values out of the object, outside the Effect. Depend on those strings instead.

slides.text: A bit repetitive, but explicit: it reconnects only if roomId or serverUrl really change.
slides.say: It is a little repetitive, but now it only reconnects when room id or server URL really change.
